messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — MidMarket account 'Greenfield Labs' flagged at 60% onboarding completion, renewal in 28 days.

sophie_csm: Seen the pulse. What's blocked?

maria_cs: Main blockers: SSO SAML errors, docs ticket backlog, and feature parity questions re embeddings. They hit an error at `auth.verify_saml` step.

jake_se: I can triage SAML tomorrow AM. Can you share error logs? If it's cert mismatch we can patch quickly.

maria_cs: Pasting snippet from customer: ``ERROR 401: SAML response certificate does not match issuer`` — raised support ticket #4872.

ashok_eng: @jake_se ok to rotate cert with them during maintenance window. Please coordinate with Sophie for times.

sophie_csm: I'll propose a window — options: Tue 9-10am PT or Wed 3-4pm PT. Which works for the customer?

maria_cs: Customer prefers Wed afternoon. Also worried about usage thresholds post-onboard; they may downgrade if latency persists.

ben_revops: If we need a temporary downgrade path, recommend: 1) switch to Standard tier with lowered concurrency, 2) enable `prefix-cache` to save tokens, 3) set a 30-day downgrade hold. I can draft the offer language.

jake_se: For immediate mitigation, we can enable a compatibility shim on the SSO proxy. ~30m work, low risk.

sophie_csm: Plan: (1) Patch shim Wed 3:00pm PT, (2) Firebase ticket owner will confirm SAML cert rotation Wed 3:30pm, (3) Offer a 30-day reduced-rate plan and dedicated onboarding hours. @ben_revops can you write the email template?

ben_revops: On it. Will share draft in this thread by EOD.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Customer 'Greenfield Labs' onboarding milestones updated — SSO blocker added to #secure-auth.

maria_cs: Also want to capture feedback: they asked for clearer examples for embedding logs -> product should add a short 'observability' guide. @ashok_eng can product intake from this thread?

ashok_eng: Will add a quick doc PR and link it in the onboarding checklist.

sophie_csm: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer after the Wed window, push the downgrade offer if latency risk remains.

maria_cs: Closing loop — please annotate support ticket #4872 with the downgrade offer and next steps. :thumbsup:
